College/Institute Goals

TEACHER EDUCATION PATHWAYS COURSE SYLLABUS
Education for personal renewal and social transformation.
A leading future-ready education university responsive to national and global development goals and directions
Philippine Normal University is committed to lead innovative, responsive and sustainable teacher education programs that set the standards of future-ready teachers and education leaders. As the National Center for Teacher Education, the Philippine Normal University commits to provide inclusive, innovative, impactful, and sustainable teacher education programs that produce future-ready teachers and education leaders imbued with the values of truth, excellence, and service. Furthermore, PNU shall ensure the continual improvement of its Quality Management System through compliance with International Quality Standards and statutory and regulatory requirements. PNU shall achieve these commitments through its core functions of instruction, research, extension, and production. Digitally Literate and Data-Driven Decision Maker Design Thinker and Innovator Discerning and Compassionate Person Dynamic Lifelong Learner and Leader Deeply Rooted Global Citizen The College of Teacher Development (CTD) is committed to the development of innovative teachers and educational leaders through the pursuit of its Goals which are aligned with the Philippine Normal University Vision, Mission, Goals. Strategic Development Plan (SDP) and Quality Objectives. Strategic Area 1: Strategic Goal 1.1 Curriculum ● Sustain excellence and leadership in all academic programs, in-service training, and other professional services through a
comprehensive PNU Modernization program. ● Create alternative ways of delivering curricular programs accessible at the national and international levels.

● Utilize ICT in the exploration and evaluation of program delivery in different context and modalities.
● Apply inclusive, integrative and innovative teaching models, approaches and delivery modes.
● Create and test high-impact innovative pedagogical teaching and assessment approaches based on best practices and models at the national and international levels.
Innovate developmentally appropriate teaching approaches and methodologies that promote technology - based and self-directed learning.
● Intellectual Competencies. Higher levels of comprehension (textual, visual, etc.) Proficient and effective communication (writing, speaking, and use of new technologies) Understanding of basic concepts across the domains of knowledge Critical, analytical, and creative thinking Application of different analytical modes (quantitative and qualitative, artistic and scientific, textual and visual, experimental, observation, etc.) in tackling problems methodologically
● Personal and Civic Responsibilities. Appreciation of the human condition Capacity to personally interpret the human experience Ability to view the contemporary world from both Philippines and global perspectives Self-assuredness in knowing and being Filipino Capacity to reflect critically on shared concerns and think of innovative, creative solutions guided by ethical standards Ability to reflect on moral norms/imperatives as they affect individuals and society Ability to appreciate and contribute to artistic beauty Understanding and respect for human rights Ability to contribute personally and meaningfully to the country’s development.
TGED-SS01
UNDERSTANDING THE SELF
NONE The course is intended to enable the process of self-exploration and to achieve self-awareness. This is realized through an understanding and appreciation of the various concepts and processes in the development and enhancement of personality, self, and identity for personal and societal development. 1. Course Intended Learning Outcomes

1.

This course intends to target the following GCED – PNU Themes: • Culture and Intercultural Relations; • Socio-economic development and interdependence; • Institutions, conflicts, social justice and human rights
The Sustainable Development Goals targeted by this course:
● SDG 3: Ensure healthy lives and promote well-being for all at all ages
● SDG 4: Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all ● SDG 5: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls
● SDG 16: Achieve gender equality and empower all women and girls Promote peaceful and inclusive societies for sustainable development, provide access to justice for all and build effective, accountable and inclusive institutions at all levels

PNU is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive academic environment for students from various backgrounds, including those with

disabilities, exceptionalities, ethnic and linguistic differences, religious affiliations, gender identities, and other individual differences. The

University ensures its commitment to equal access, participation, and engagement with educational opportunities that supports our academic

culture and values as well as celebrate diversity and inclusivity.

If you have any physical or psychological/ mental health conditions or challenges which can affect your performance in class, you are encouraged to inform me. This is to ensure that we are creating and fostering a responsive classroom environment. You are also encouraged to avail of the services of the following offices regarding your challenge/ condition: - Student Affairs and Services Office: counselingservices@pnu.edu.ph - University Health Services Unit: uhsu@pnu.edu.ph - Gender, Equity, Diversity, and Inclusivity Office: gedio@pnu.edu.ph

Class guidelines ● Read the UG Student Handbook 2024. ● Attend the class regularly and on time. ● Participate and engage in the class discussion and activities. ● Maintain a respectful and peaceful atmosphere and communication. ● Monitor one’s academic performance responsibly. ● If there is any concern, communicate with the professor.

Rubrics for Reflection Paper (20 points):

Criteria Understanding of Content
Personal Insight
Organization & Clarity Grammar & Mechanics

Excellent (5 pts) Demonstrates deep understanding of seminar themes and concepts.
Thoughtful reflection with strong personal connection to the topic.
Well-structured, logical flow, and easy to follow. Virtually no errors; writing is polished and professional.

Good (4 pts)
Shows good understanding with minor gaps.
Includes personal reflection with some depth.
Mostly clear and organized.
Few minor errors that don’t hinder readability.

Satisfactory (3 pts)
Basic understanding; some parts unclear or generalized.

Needs Improvement (2-0 pts)
Limited or inaccurate understanding of the seminar content.

Some personal insight, but not Minimal or no personal connection;

well-developed.

mostly surface-level.

Somewhat organized; transitions may be weak.

Disorganized or difficult to follow.

Noticeable errors but generally Frequent grammar/spelling issues

understandable.

that interfere with understanding.

Points /5
/5 /5 /5

Rubric for an Advocacy Post in Social Media:

Criteria
Message Clarity & Relevance
Purpose & Call to Action
Creativity & Engagement
Grammar & Presentation

Excellent (5 pts)
Clear, focused, and strongly connected to the advocacy issue.
Strong and compelling purpose with a clear call to action (CTA).
Very creative and engaging; uses visuals or language effectively.
No errors; well-written and visually clean/professional.

Good (4 pts)
Message is mostly clear and relevant.
Purpose is evident; CTA is present but could be stronger.
Some creativity and audience engagement strategies.
Minor errors that don’t affect readability.

Satisfactory (3 pts) Message is present but somewhat vague.
CTA is weak or vague.
Limited creativity; average engagement. Some errors; slightly affect readability.

Needs Improvement (2-0 pts)
Message is unclear, off-topic, or confusing.
No clear purpose or call to action.
Lacks creativity and does not engage the audience.
Frequent grammar/spelling errors; post looks unpolished.

Points /5 /5 /5 /5

Rubric for Capstone Project (Short Video Presentation: 30 points

Criteria
Content Accuracy & Relevance
Creativity & Engagement Organization & Clarity
Team Collaboration

Excellent (5 pts)
Information is accurate, complete, and deeply connected to the topic.
Highly creative and engaging; keeps viewer attention throughout. Clear flow of ideas; well-structured beginning, middle, and end. All members participate equally and meaningfully.

Good (4 pts)
Mostly accurate and relevant, with minor gaps.
Creative and engaging in most parts.
Mostly organized and easy to follow.
Most members contribute actively.

Satisfactory (3 pts)
Basic understanding shown; some ideas unclear or offtopic.
Some creativity, but parts are dull or repetitive.
Organization is present but occasionally confusing.
Uneven participation among members.

Technical Quality

High-quality visuals, audio, and editing enhance the message.

Good quality with few technical issues.

Acceptable quality but some distracting issues.

Understanding & Insight

Shows deep insight into the topic and reflects personal or group understanding.

Shows clear

Shows basic understanding;

understanding with some limited insight.

insight.

Needs Improvement (2-0 pts)
Content lacks relevance or contains major inaccuracies.
Lacks creativity or viewer engagement. Lacks clear structure; difficult to follow. One or two members dominate or others have minimal roles. Poor quality that interferes with understanding or message delivery.
Lacks clear understanding of the topic.

Points /5 /5 /5 /5 /5

Rubric for a Career Plan (20 points):

Criteria
Clarity of Career Goal Action Plan & Steps
Self-Assessment
Feasibility & Realism

Excellent (5 pts)

Good (4 pts)

Clearly stated, specific, and realistic career Clear but somewhat

goal.

general.

Well-detailed steps with logical timeline and strategies.

Clear steps with some detail.

Thoughtful reflection on interests, strengths, and values.

Some reflection with relevant insights.

Plan is practical and considers potential challenges and solutions.

Mostly feasible with minor gaps.

Satisfactory (3 pts)
Vague or overly broad. Steps present but lacking detail or order. Basic self-awareness shown. Plan is somewhat realistic but lacks depth.

Needs Improvement (2-0 Points pts)
Unclear, unrealistic, or /5 missing. Few or unclear steps; lacks /5 direction. Minimal or no self- /5 assessment. Impractical or poorly /5 thought out.
